text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- U.S. president Bill Clinton welcomes in a letter the meeting of the Hungarian and the Romanian presidents, which both parties called 'historic'.
-- The Hungarian Eximbank concluded agreements worth $12 million in Bucharest on loans to help Romanians buy Hungarian goods.
-- The transport ministry has not announced yet how motoway fees should change.
-- Hungary plans to spend more than 500 million forints for modernising the computer system to be used at the general elections in May 1998.
